verdict.rationale: Docs confirm both hosted onboarding (Adyen-hosted pages/UI) and API-only onboarding where developers build their own UI, plus Legal Entity Management API for KYC/KYB and balance account creation. However, evidence doesn't explicitly show bank account linking flows or terms-of-service acceptance steps within these onboarding paths, nor mention of embeddable/drop-in components (as opposed to fully hosted or fully custom) for onboarding forms specifically. missing for 10: explicit bank account linking API/flow detail, terms-of-service acceptance mechanism, embeddable component (vs. only hosted/API-only binary) evidence, independent developer corroboration of the onboarding UX.
